posts.title: Did I mention
posts.description: My pal Jesse Jarnow had me back on his essential Good Ol’ Grateful Deadcast to talk about a show I saw in the summer of 1985, at Merriweather Post Pavilion in Columbia, Maryland, and the best by far rendition of “Shakedown Street” I ever saw live or have ever heard in a recording.
